new='''def transform(grid):
    """Mark cells where the two nonzero patterns on either side overlap."""
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    # Find a full, nonzero divider whose two panels have matching dimensions.
    for r in range(h):
        value = grid[r][0]
        if value != 0 and all(x == value for x in grid[r]):
            top, bottom = r, h - r - 1
            if top == bottom:
                return [[2 if grid[i][c] != 0 and grid[r + 1 + i][c] != 0 else 0
                         for c in range(w)] for i in range(top)]
    for c in range(w):
        value = grid[0][c]
        if value != 0 and all(row[c] == value for row in grid):
            left, right = c, w - c - 1
            if left == right:
                return [[2 if grid[r][i] != 0 and grid[r][c + 1 + i] != 0 else 0
                         for i in range(left)] for r in range(h)]
    raise ValueError("no centered full divider")
'''
